time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Waste composition as given in literature reference, theoretical data or other source. Transfer coefficients from prospective model.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Technology encountered in Switzerland in 2000. Landfill includes base seal and leachate collection system.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Swiss residual material landfill for polluted, inorganic waste. With base seal and leachate collection system. Recultivation after closure.

# Included processes
Waste-specific short-term emissions to water from leachate. Long-term emissions from landfill to ground water.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Landfill model based on observed leachate concentrations in literature. Extrapolated to 60'000 years heeding chemical characteristics. Initial waste composition from various literature sources.
